purpose: Authoritative reuse-rights review for the highest-value measured waveform sources that were blocked only because public download availability had not yet been tied to explicit dataset reuse terms.

evidenceBoundary: This review changes execution eligibility only where version-specific reuse terms are explicit and internally consistent. Historical or harvested licence metadata is retained as evidence but is not silently propagated across changed dataset versions, and conflicting official metadata remains fail-closed. No dataset is promoted to fully profiled measured evidence and no accepted measured-sample count changes until source files are lawfully retrieved, fingerprinted, profiled and reconciled.
